Chapter 378: Chapter 4 Golden Dragon Star Master: Jin Tianzhao, this is the good deed you have done! (Please subscribe)

“These privileges…”

Lin Yuan meticulously perused the email sent from the Central Star Domain.

Every time Lin Yuan’s citizen rank was promoted, he would receive blessings and introductions from the Central Star Domain.

Compared to a Sixth-Level Citizen, the added privileges and benefits of a Seventh-Level Citizen were not many, but each was significant.

Firstly, every Seventh-Level Citizen would receive a Seventh-Rank Evolution Elixir and a Seventh-Rank Longevity Elixir gifted by the Central Star Domain.

The Seventh-Rank Evolution Elixir was similar in use to the Sixth-Rank Evolution Elixir. After consumption, it could promote one’s physical soul to the Seventh Layer without any sequelae.

...

Of course, this promotion referred only to a basic improvement. The abilities such as the understanding of rules that a Seventh Rank Evolver realized were absent.

The reason Central Star Domain did this was considering that many Seventh-Level citizens perhaps were not high in evolutive talent.

Throughout their lives, they might never be able to train up to the Fifth or Sixth Rank.

And the Evolution Elixir was to make up for this deficiency.

Although lacking in understanding of rules, reaching the Seventh Layer could at least explode their lifespan to over a hundred thousand years.

Plus, with the Seventh-Rank Longevity Elixir, each Seventh-Level Citizen, regardless of how poor their evolutionary talent, could live between two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand years.

Human Civilization takes each Seventh-Level Citizen very seriously, hoping they live longer.

This is also seen as a way to repay their contributions to human civilization, and perhaps those who live longer might be able to contribute even more?

“Seventh-Rank Evolution Elixir huh…”

Lin Yuan felt a slight emotion. Such an elixir that could promote a person to the Seventh Layer without any risk was coveted by countless major powers and noble families.

Not for themselves.

But for their beloved kin or favorite offspring and so forth.

Unfortunately, so far, only the official human civilization could provide a stable supply of such evolution elixirs.

As for other powers? The strength-enhancing elixirs they provided typically had some risks or hidden dangers.

…

“Automatically become a ‘Councilor’ of the Annan Star Alliance?”

Lin Yuan looked at the second privilege of a Seventh-Level Citizen.

Annan Star Alliance, belonging to the Chikun Star Domain, covers hundreds of surrounding star domains.

Although the Annan Star Alliance doesn’t have absolute command over the Chikun Star Lord, it still has some degree of authority over its jurisdiction.

Being able to become a ‘Councilor’ of the Annan Star Alliance is without exception a position held by absolute major figures, at the level of the Chikun Star Lord, Golden Dragon Star Master.

A typical star domain’s Star Lord couldn’t possibly amass two million merit points to elevate to a Seventh-Level Citizen rank.

Currently, the Annan Star Alliance has fifty-six councilors, of whom thirty-one have concealed their identities, and the other twenty-five are well-known giants within many star domains.

“As a star alliance councilor, one has the power of veto. If one deems there’s an issue in any dispute, it can be vetoed, awaiting the next star alliance congress to reconvene and discuss anew.”

“This power of veto can be used up to three times on the same issue, and after three times, it can no longer be applied.”

Lin Yuan glanced over the powers of a star alliance councilor.

This mainly prevents any councilor from being unreasonably obstinate, but even so, it’s quite astounding.

Of course, the three goddesses granted the star alliance councilors such power because the debates that occur in the star alliance congress generally have no significant impact on the grand scheme of human civilization.

Or they do not touch upon any core or baseline issues related to human civilization.

No matter who wins or loses, the result is more or less the same.

…

Beyond the aforementioned.

A Seventh-Level Citizen also has the right to permanently reside in the Central Star Domain, to request a guard troop led by an Eighth Layer Evolver, the highest-court pleading rights, among others.

Lin Yuan meticulously reviewed it several times. With the status of a Seventh-Level Citizen, if Lin Yuan were to apply for a position with the Goddess of Wisdom, he would at least be a governor on some main stars of the Central Star Domain, with high authority and weight.

The position of a governor on a main star in the Central Star Domain is far superior in status compared to that of the Canglan Star Governor, not even on the same level.

Even some Eighth Layer Evolvers very much desire to hold the position of a governor in the main star of the Central Star Domain, not just for the status but also as a stable channel for earning merit points.

“Unfortunately, I’m not really interested in management…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The position of a governor requires spending considerable time on planetary management, generally appealing only to those Eighth Layer Evolvers stuck at a bottleneck.

But for Lin Yuan at present, it’s the golden period for training, and opening up the Eighth Layer Part of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would be far better than any position as a governor.

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, would you like to hide your Seventh-Level Citizen identity?”

The solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

After becoming a Seventh-Level Citizen, Lin Yuan’s information would automatically appear on the councilor list of the Annan Star Alliance.

To protect the privacy of citizens, every Seventh-Level Citizen has the option to conceal their identity.

Currently, of the fifty-six councilors in the Annan Star Alliance, thirty-one have concealed their identities.

“Conceal it.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

After concealing the citizen identity, the information displayed on the councilor list would be a code name pre-set by Lin Yuan.

That is ‘Shisan.’

Choosing the code name ‘Shisan’ was an arbitrary decision by Lin Yuan, and he had no concerns about his real identity being exposed.

The Annan Star Alliance encompasses hundreds of star domains and over a billion life planets, and there are countless things related to ‘Shisan.’

Even the top divination masters, without a ‘God’s’ perspective, wouldn’t associate ‘Shisan’ with Lin Yuan.
